description: Crafted from lightweight aviation-grade aluminum alloy, installed with 349 wheelset, this small-wheel folding bike is perfect for effortless urban cycling. Featuring the innovative DAHON-V tech suite, it offers enhanced rigidity and speed. With a robust two-piece aluminum handlepost and an internal 3-speed gear system, plus highly efficient front and rear disc brakes, perfect balance between speed and versatility. Travel light with speed in every mile of your journey. Experience the difference today!
